notes: Spawn protection for spies: no damage for 5 s after each spawn, longer on the eight stock maps (14-23 s), ended early by hacking or using a gadget, with a countdown on screen. Frag grenades and the drone no longer deal full damage within 2.5 m of the blast. The smoke grenade buff and the Smoke Mine are unchanged. Everyone in a match needs this build.

addons.title: Smoke mines, spawn protection and frag blast
